title: Russian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab dish inspired by Russian cuisine, featuring tender lamb and a bold blend of spices.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together hot sauce, olive oil, onion, garlic, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and cumin.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto the kebab skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill grates with oil to prevent sticking. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
6. Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired. Serve hot with your favorite sides.
